<div class="card-body">
'''Solo Han''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">孤独なハン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらか選ぶ。１：戦闘の際、ハンが位置カードを独りで守っている時に使用できる。戦闘運命数を２枚多く引いて足せる。２：戦闘の際、エイリアンが位置カードを独りで守っている時に使用できる。戦闘運命数を１枚多く引いて足せる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-111o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">くつろいでいるように見えても、ソロは密輸屋として常に周囲に気を配らなくてはならない。バウンティ・ハンターたちは、コレリアの宇宙海賊の首にかけられた賞金に群がる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Solo Han.

'''Card text:''' Choose one. If Han is defending a battle alone at a site, add two battle destiny. If an alien is defending a battle alone, add one battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Even when he looks relaxed, Solo as a smuggler has to watch his surroundings. Bounty hunters flock to the price on the Corellian pirate's head.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese numbers the two options.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Solo Han]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
